action_items: Minor a11y: /app/frontend/src/pages/ProgramDetail.jsx Gallery lightbox DialogContent is missing a DialogTitle. Wrap a hidden DialogTitle via Radix's VisuallyHidden (or import from components/ui) to silence the console warning and improve screen-reader support.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 3307 lines (prev 3153) - file-size guideline (<700 lines) still heavily violated. The new Home-content (~80 lines), Win-backs (~25 lines), and expanded Programs section (gallery/testimonials/home-pick ~70 extra lines) continue to compound. Split into dedicated modules (home.py, winbacks.py, programs.py).

DEFAULT_HOME testimonial IDs (t-adaeze, t-louise, t-chantal) are hardcoded constants referenced by program home_testimonial_ids. If an admin deletes/renames one of these from the Home editor, saved program picks silently stop merging (no warning). Consider either (a) preserving testimonial IDs across edits, or (b) warning when a program's picked IDs no longer resolve.

/api/admin/winbacks performs N+1 queries (one payment_transactions.find per thanked cancellation). On sites with 100+ cancellations this is slow. Batch with a single $in on emails + $gt on thanked_at using aggregation.

Win-back 'returned' detection matches any paid payment_transaction created after thanked_at regardless of whether it is a new subscription/one-time or reactivation of the same sub. If a donor's existing one-time gift webhook arrives late (created_at pre-thanked but updated_at post-thanked), it could be miscounted as a win-back. Consider restricting to new session_ids distinct from the cancelled sub_id.
_clean_testimonials assigns new uuid4 when id is missing, but there is no uniqueness enforcement across the testimonials list - admin could paste a duplicate id manually. Low risk.
ProgramDetail Gallery lightbox: Dialog missing DialogTitle emits Radix console warning (a11y regression).
AdminHome ImageUpload supports photo_url for testimonials but there is no size/dimension cap enforced client-side; server trusts upload path.
GalleryEditor uploads files sequentially in a for-loop instead of Promise.all; batch upload of 10 photos is slower than necessary.
HomePicks fetches /home-content on every ProgramForm open; could use the already-cached home-content from useHomeContent.js to avoid an extra request.
